name: Opik
oneLine: Open-source LLM observability, evaluation and optimization platform from Comet, with hosted cloud and self-hosting.

selfHostStack.value: Docker Compose or Kubernetes: Java backend, Python backend, frontend, ClickHouse, MySQL, Redis, MinIO, ZooKeeper

selfHostLicence.value: Apache-2.0 for the full platform; docs say self-hosted has no user management features

cloudFree.value: Free Cloud $0: 10 team members, 25k spans/month, 60-day retention

cloudPaidFrom.value: Pro Cloud $19/month flat incl. 100k spans; extra spans $5 per 100k

otel.value: OTLP over HTTP only (gRPC unsupported); GenAI and OpenInference conventions; endpoint /api/v1/private/otel

sql.value: Not documented: docs describe OQL, a SQL-like filter syntax used in SDK search methods

mcp.value: MCP server for coding agents: read traces, find failures, analyze experiments, add tracing

onlineEvals.value: Yes: online evaluation rules with LLM-as-a-Judge score new production traces as they arrive

datasetsExperiments.value: Yes: datasets, experiments and side-by-side comparison of versions

promptManagement.value: Yes: Prompt Library with immutable sequential versions, via UI or SDK

gateway.value: Opik LLM Gateway: OpenAI-format proxy, beta, described as for development and testing

alerts.value: Alerts to Slack, PagerDuty or any webhook on trace errors, cost, latency, feedback scores, prompt and experiment events

annotationQueues.value: Queues of traces or threads for reviewers, with instructions and feedback scores; labels can align LLM judges

assistant.value: Ollie: chat next to traces, datasets, experiments and prompts; with opik connect it reads and edits your code
assistant.short: Ollie chat; edits code via connect

codingAgents.value: Guides for Claude Code (plugin or OpenTelemetry), Cursor, GitHub Copilot and OpenAI Codex sessions

chooseThem: Full platform under Apache-2.0 plus a managed cloud from Comet, so you can use either
Evaluation tooling: datasets, experiments, online LLM-as-judge and agent optimization
Kubernetes Helm deployment with ClickHouse, and a Comet enterprise deployment option
Flat $19/month Pro cloud price and a free cloud tier with 10 team members
